Dashed: initial40×22.5 view. Open circle: operating approach. Dot: incoming spawn.
Shared operational handover and records triage; central orientation and return contact.
High clerestory, orthogonal service spine and a recognisable staffed operations island.

window. Beyond initial view: North incident/plan bays and west/east
thresholds require purposeful movement; central crossing and operations
Main spine4 tiles/128 px; secondary and doors3 tiles/96 px. Actual player32×42 px.
Footprint blocks only its visible base; overhead cap uses an authored contact anchor.
Camera clamped to room, never to task result.

becomes steady. No new primary opportunity. Existing entry state and
